content: Elasticsearch filtering conventions (elastic.co docs, cross-verified): query context scores, filter context is yes/no with no scoring and automatic caching; filter entry points bool.filter/must_not, constant_score, post_filter. Retrievers (8.14+, GA 8.16): RRF compound retriever propagates its filter element to ALL sub-retrievers (pre-filter inside each leg incl. kNN, not post-fusion); rank_constant default 60, rank_window_size default 10 >= size; RRF discards raw scores. post_filter exists for aggregation-preserving late filtering, not the hybrid pattern.
